# psaverse

The package `psaverse` will facilitate archiving and sharing all of the
data and materials for Psychological Science Accelerator projects in a
standardized, transparent way. The eventual goal is to collect a number
of individual R packages developed by the PSA under this name as a
collection.

## Installation

You can install the development version of psaverse from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("psysciacc/psaverse")
```

ethcis - irb, power - power, r scirpts/markdown files, smaple sieze,
estimates material - translations (survey doc, items) (lot of them are
xl, csv) procedure - entire survey qualtric file, word doc, scripts java
data - csvs (chk if they r large \>100MB per file) analysis - r
scripts/markdown comm - presentations, markdown, with a conf name
other - other

# Package index

## All functions

- [`proj_desc()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/proj_desc.md)
  : usethis project description functions
- [`psa_add_author()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_add_author.md)
  : Add Author Info to PSA Project
- [`psa_add_documents()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_add_documents.md)
  : Add Documents to Project
- [`psa_check_folder()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_check_folder.md)
  : Check PSA Project Folder Structure
- [`psa_citation()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_citation.md)
  : Create PSA Citation for Project
- [`psa_create_folder()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_create_folder.md)
  : Create Folders in Project
- [`psa_create_metadata()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_create_metadata.md)
  : Create Metadata for each folder
- [`psa_create_project()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_create_project.md)
  : Create PSA Project
- [`psa_dependencies()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_dependencies.md)
  : Add R package dependencies for analysis code
- [`psa_git()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_git.md) :
  Add R package to PsySciAcc Organization
- [`psa_update_description()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_update_description.md)
  : Create/Update PSA Project Description
- [`psa_view_folder()`](http://psysciacc.org/psaverse/reference/psa_view_folder.md)
  : View metadata for a folder
